what.en: The street address of the building or lease space applying for the certificate itself, with suite or unit. Not a mailing, head-office or overseas address, and not a P.O. box. Street line only; the space number and ZIP have their own lines.
what.zh: 填写申请占用证的建筑或租赁空间本身的街道地址（含门牌号/单元号）。不能填写邮寄地址、总部地址、海外地址或邮政信箱。此处只填街道部分，单元号和邮编另有专栏。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.
ifNone.zh: 此栏填写的是申请许可的美国经营地点本身，没有替代方案：请先签订租约或确定场地，再用该地址申请。

confirmations.quote: Physical address of the location that is applying for the certificate
A Certificate of Occupancy must be obtained before a commercial building or an individual lease space within a commercial building may be occupied
If your business relocates to another address, you will need to apply for a CO for that location.

what.en: The building or suite number of the space applying for the certificate, if it has one.
what.zh: 申请占用证的空间的楼号或单元号（如有）。

what.en: The ZIP code of the business location (the form's own example labels it 'Business zip').
what.zh: 营业地点的邮编（表格示例标注为“Business zip”）。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.

A Certificate of Occupancy must be obtained before a commercial building or an individual lease space within a commercial building may be occupied
If your business relocates to another address, you will need to apply for a CO for that location.

what.en: The home street address of the person signing the application (the authorized agent). The sources do not say whether an address outside the US is accepted.
what.zh: 签署申请的人（授权代理人）的住址街道部分。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。

ifNone.en: Give the signer's actual residential or business address. If it is abroad, Placetta asks the agency first whether a foreign address is accepted on this line.
ifNone.zh: 请填写签署人真实的住址或办公地址。如该地址在境外，Placetta 会先向该机构确认此栏是否接受境外地址。

what.zh: 签署人住址的城市、州和邮编。此栏没有国家一项。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。
